title: Dispatch: restore missing simple C2 payload clauses on ten magic items (attempt 1)
description:
PR #455 review finding batch B1 (importer-fix-protocol applies). The 2026-07-06 reviewed inventory (docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-7-3-magic-item-mechanics-inventory.md §2) names these deterministic payload clauses, but the committed mechanics omit them. Add source-exact effects (and operation/trigger bindings where noted), mostly in magicItemResidualCombatEffects.ts / magicItemActivatedEffects.ts:
1. oathbow: extra 3d6 piercing damage on hit vs sworn enemy (C2).
2. dagger-of-venom: coated-blade hit payload — DC 15 Con save or 2d10 poison damage + poisoned 1 minute (C2; bind to the M5 'coated' state/hit trigger).
3. giant-slayer: on-hit vs giant — DC 15 Str save or fall prone (extra 2d6 already present; add the prone save).
4. hammer-of-thunderbolts: (a) nat-20 attack vs giant — DC 17 Con save or die; (b) hurl-thunderclap operation is an empty shell: add range/attack semantics per source ('range 20/60... on hit 'every creature within 30 feet... DC 17 Con or stunned') and its payload effect + activation.
5. mace-of-disruption: on hit fiend/undead with <=25 hp after damage — DC 15 Wis save or destroyed; on success frightened until end of your next turn (2d6 radiant already present).
6. nine-lives-stealer: crit vs creature with <100 hp — DC 15 Con save or slain (constructs/undead immune); ties to the charge decrement.
7. iron-flask: target DC 17 Wis save to trap (advantage if previously trapped) (C2).
8. mirror-of-life-trapping: DC 15 Cha save on seeing reflection (advantage for creatures knowing the mirror's nature exists already as separate effects — verify; the DC-15 save payload itself is missing).
9. cloak-of-arachnida: cast web at fixed save DC 13 (castSpell effect currently missing the DC).
10. robe-of-eyes: light/daylight blindness drawback — blinded 1 minute; end-of-turn Con save DC 11 (light) / DC 15 (daylight) ends it.
Verify each against the record's own description before writing (source of truth). Update membership/frequency/clause allowlists explicitly; regenerate the pack; full verify:worktree.
notes: Completion report (2026-07-19): Read docs/importer-fix-protocol.md, docs/rules-pack-compiler.md, and packages/core/scripts/importers/AGENTS.md before editing. Restored source-phrase-guarded C2 payloads for ten item records: cloak-of-arachnida, dagger-of-venom, giant-slayer, hammer-of-thunderbolts, iron-flask, mace-of-disruption, mirror-of-life-trapping, oathbow, nine-lives-stealer, and robe-of-eyes. Every numeric/detail field was checked against the item record's own data.description: DCs, save abilities, 3d6/2d10/2d6 dice, 1-minute durations, prone/poisoned/blinded/frightened/stunned outcomes, thresholds, ranges, immunity, and charge behavior. Changed family projectors, focused regression tests, canonical records.json, semi-structured boundary JSON/Markdown, and clause census expectations (1001 -> 1012; engine-pending 780 -> 791). Generated diff is limited to the ten intended magic-item records and associated execution-readiness clauses; no record-count or source-ledger churn. Commands/results: focused importer tests 12 passed; npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1 succeeded; npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack reported 0 added/removed/changed records and all three source artifacts exact; npm run verify:worktree passed format/check/typecheck and full suite (260 files passed, 4 skipped; 4638 passed, 19 skipped). Follow-up created: eshyra-vumb for typed schema/deterministic ownership of the newly exposed irregular qualifier fields.
close_reason: Implemented and verified the ten source-grounded C2 payload restorations; follow-up eshyra-vumb tracks remaining typed ownership work.
